title: Constrained Subsequence Sum
description: Find the maximum sum of a non-empty subsequence such that for every two consecutive integers in the subsequence, their indices i and j satisfy j - i <= k.
pseudocode:
1: deque = []
2: dp = new Array(nums.length)
3: maxSum = -Infinity
4: for i = 0 to nums.length - 1:
5:   dp[i] = nums[i] + (deque.length ? dp[deque[0]] : 0)
6:   maxSum = max(maxSum, dp[i])
7:   while deque.length && dp[i] > dp[deque[deque.length - 1]]: deque.pop()
8:   if dp[i] > 0: deque.push(i)
9:   if deque.length && deque[0] == i - k: deque.shift()

steps.note: Initialize loop for i=0. nums=[10, -2, -10], k=2
Remove index 0 from deque as it is out of range k
